subject: general
question: In the 1974 edition of the Guinness Book of Records, which playback singer was mentioned as the most recorded artist in human history?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar**, often referred to as the **Nightingale of India**, is one of the greatest playback singers in the history of Indian cinema.
 
• She was recognized in the **1974 edition of the Guinness Book of Records** as the most recorded artist in human history for having sung thousands of songs in various **Indian languages**.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar's career spanned over seven decades, during which she recorded songs in **Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and more.**
 
• Her songs covered a wide range of genres, showcasing her **versatility and unmatched vocal quality.**
 
• She worked with almost every leading music composer of her time, including **RD Burman, SD Burman, Shankar-Jaikishan, Naushad, and Laxmikant-Pyarelal.**
 
• Lata Mangeshkar received numerous awards, including the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **2001**.
 
• Her contribution to Indian music has left a profound impact, making her an iconic figure in the country's cultural history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pulapaka Susheela**__

 __
 
• **Pulapaka Susheela** is an iconic playback singer primarily associated with South Indian cinema.
 
• She has recorded thousands of songs in multiple languages such as **Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam.**
 
• P. Susheela has been recognized by Guinness World Records for singing the most songs in Indian languages, the record is for the highest number of solo, duet, and chorus-backed songs (17,695)
 
• Her melodious voice and ability to convey emotions have made her a beloved figure in Indian music.
 
 
 
• **KS Chithra**__
 __
 
• **KS Chithra**, also known as Chinna Kuyil (Little Nightingale), is a renowned playback singer from Kerala.
 
• She has sung thousands of songs in various languages including **Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi, and Bengali.**
 
• Chithra is a recipient of numerous awards including **six National Film Awards** and several Filmfare awards.
 
• Her songs are recognized for their **melody and emotional depth.**
 
 
 
• **Alka Yagnik**__
 
 
• **Alka Yagnik** is a leading playback singer in Bollywood, known for her melodious voice.
 
• She has sung numerous hit songs in Hindi and other Indian languages, collaborating with famous composers like **Anu Malik, Jatin-Lalit, and Nadeem-Shravan.**
 
• She is a recipient of multiple awards, including **Filmfare Awards** and the **National Film Award.**
